_about.label: oracle-simulator practice with sparse external evaluation
_about.experiment: sweep_blocks, condition F under the expanded allowances. NOT RUN (prepared 2026-11-27).
_about.compared_with: the 10 x 10 experiment (sweep_blocks_10x10_usd120_sim600.json): the same initial program A (the snapshot of out/xsim/sweep_blocks/rep0) and the same development panel (the first 10 scenes of the frozen 20), in a root of its own made with xsim/fork_root.py
_about.development: $120 after initialization; 600 practice interactions in the target simulator, executed scene checks counted, judged by F's own self-check (the official verdict is not exposed to it and does not control practice termination); separately at most 10 submissions x 10 development scenes, judged by the official evaluator, as for B, C and D.
_about.oracle_reference: F receives up to 600 + 100 = 700 target-simulator interactions (B, C, D: 100). Its extra target-simulator practice makes it an oracle reference, not a target-interaction-matched comparison.
